name: window-management
title: Window Management
description: Search-invoked macOS window placement commands for Vicinae
author: xavierchanth

commands.name: left-half
commands.title: Window: Left Half
commands.description: Move the active window to the left half

commands.name: right-half
commands.title: Window: Right Half
commands.description: Move the active window to the right half

commands.name: top-left-quarter
commands.title: Window: Top Left Quarter
commands.description: Move the active window to the top-left quarter

commands.name: top-right-quarter
commands.title: Window: Top Right Quarter
commands.description: Move the active window to the top-right quarter

commands.name: bottom-left-quarter
commands.title: Window: Bottom Left Quarter
commands.description: Move the active window to the bottom-left quarter

commands.name: bottom-right-quarter
commands.title: Window: Bottom Right Quarter
commands.description: Move the active window to the bottom-right quarter

commands.name: maximize
commands.title: Window: Maximize
commands.description: Maximize the active window within the usable screen

commands.name: restore
commands.title: Window: Restore Previous Bounds
commands.description: Restore the active window to its previous bounds

commands.name: center
commands.title: Window: Center
commands.description: Center the active window on its current screen

commands.name: next-display
commands.title: Window: Next Display
commands.description: Move the active window to the next display

commands.name: previous-display
commands.title: Window: Previous Display
commands.description: Move the active window to the previous display

commands.name: resize
commands.title: Window: Resize
commands.description: Resize and center the active window
